artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan for the shared team-mode fan-out stage (Stage 3.6 skeleton + Stage 3.6a per-phase teammate-plan builder) in skill-orchestrate, plus --team/--team-size on orchestrate.md.

memory_candidates.content: When collapsing N duplicated orchestration flows into one shared stage, check whether the duplicates actually share a shape before parameterizing. In this agent system the three team skills looked uniform but were not: research/plan spawn a FIXED named-role set with letter-suffixed artifact files, while implement spawns a DYNAMIC set keyed to plan phases in dependency waves, with real source-file ownership and an ad-hoc debugger role. The correct factoring is a shared skeleton (availability check, spawn, wait, collect, correlate, stage, clean up) plus a per-phase builder that returns a uniform teammate-tuple array; the skeleton never learns which phase produced the tuples. This mirrors the existing handler/dispatch-prep relationship, where per-status handlers differ in dispatch content but share one sub-call.
